segments.name: Colquijirca
segments.description: Copper and silver mine at Colquijirca and Marcapunta in Cerro de Pasco, selling copper, silver and gold to metal and concentrate buyers.
segments.evidence: (a) Colquijirca . Sales of goods increased by 13% in 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to an increase of 11% and 51% in the realized copper and silver prices in this mining unit, which was partially offset by a 21% and 11% decrease in the volumes of copper and silver sold, respectively, related to the lower ore grade and its impact in production.

segments.name: Uchucchacua/Yumpag
segments.description: Silver mine at Uchucchacua and Yumpag in Pasco whose ore is processed at the nearby Uchucchacua plant and sold as silver, lead and zinc.
segments.evidence: (b) Uchucchacua/Yumpag . Sales of goods increased by 60% in 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to a 10%, 21% and 25% increase in the volumes of silver, lead and zinc sold, respectively, related to the full year operation of Yumaq in 2025 compared to eight months in 2024.

segments.name: Orcopampa
segments.description: Gold and silver mine in Peru producing precious metals sold to metal and concentrate buyers.
segments.evidence: We also conducted exploration leading to the discovery of gold mineralization and subsequent production of gold at our Orcopampa, La Zanja and Tambomayo mines.

segments.name: Tambomayo
segments.description: Gold, silver, lead, zinc and copper mine in Peru whose output is sold as metal and concentrates to customers.
segments.evidence: (d) Tambomayo. Sales of goods decreased by 14 % in 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to a 20%, 49% and 40% decrease in the volumes of silver, zinc and lead sold, respectively.

segments.name: Julcani
segments.description: Silver and gold mine in Peru selling silver, gold, lead and copper to metal and concentrate customers.
segments.evidence: During the first several decades of our operations, we focused on the exploration and development of silver mines in Peru, including our Julcani, Orcopampa and Uchucchacua mines.

segments.name: La Zanja
segments.description: Gold and silver mine in Peru selling precious metals to metal buyers and to other units of the Group.
segments.evidence: We currently operate El Brocal (Colquijirca-Marcapunta), Uchucchacua/Yumpag, Orcopampa, Tambomayo, Julcani, and La Zanja mines and have a non-controlling interest in the Coimolache mine.

revenueModel.text: Customers in Peru and abroad buy the gold, silver, copper, lead and zinc sold as metal and concentrates from the company's mines.
revenueModel.evidence: As a result of these initiatives, the majority of our revenues are now derived from the production of gold, silver and copper.

changes.text: In 2025 the company classified the Poracota and Shila-Paula mining units as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we have classified two mining units as units with discontinued operations: Poracota and Shila-Paula.

changes.text: In 2024 the company sold its holdings in Chaupiloma, the collector of royalties from the Yanacocha mine.
changes.evidence: Buenaventura, together with its subsidiary Compañía Minera Condesa S.A. (Condesa), sold their holdings in their jointly-wholly owned subsidiary S.M.R.L. Chaupiloma Dos de Cajamarca (Chaupiloma), the collector of royalties from the Yanacocha mine

changes.text: Rental of mining concessions stopped being a segment in July 2024.
